sources.page: Deel I, artikel 1.1, pagina 3, PDF p. 3
sources.note: Article 1.1 defines the short name KNSA for the association. The rules are one book in ten parts: Deel I holds the general provisions, Deel IV the rules for large-bore rifle (Groot Kaliber Geweer).

sources.page: Deel I, title page, PDF p. 1
sources.note: The association's postal address is in Leusden, the Netherlands; the national championships of the rules are those of the Netherlands.

sources.title: Homepage of the KNSA
